scope.limitation: Selected pages only; not a complete website or catalog audit.

questions.question: Can AI recommend the right product format for the customer?
questions.requiredInformation: Clearly named products and formats, so AI can distinguish coffee that needs brewing from instant coffee or machine capsules.
questions.sampleFinding: Formats are stated directly and linked to named products. AI has enough information to select a format without inferring it from a photo.
questions.scope: Selected products relevant to this question; illustrative scope only

questions.question: Can AI choose a coffee that matches the requested roast?
questions.requiredInformation: A specific roast level for each relevant product, so AI can distinguish medium-roast choices from the classic dark roast.
questions.sampleFinding: Each selected product has a direct roast label. AI can distinguish the medium-roast option from the classic dark roast.
questions.scope: Selected products relevant to this question; illustrative scope only

questions.question: Can AI match a coffee to the customer’s taste preferences?
questions.requiredInformation: Specific, supported flavor descriptions and distinctions between products—for example, smoky versus chocolatey, or mild versus intense.
questions.sampleFinding: “Bold” and “distinct” provide little detail about actual flavor differences. AI would need to infer which product fits a more specific preference.
questions.scope: Selected products relevant to this question; illustrative scope only

questions.question: Can AI recommend a coffee for the customer’s brewing method?
questions.requiredInformation: Product-specific grind and brewing suitability, with concise preparation guidance where needed to establish the match.
questions.sampleFinding: Methods are named, but the sample does not clearly connect each selected ground coffee’s grind and preparation guidance to those methods.
questions.scope: Selected products relevant to this question; illustrative scope only

questions.question: Can AI recommend a product that fits the customer’s machine?
questions.requiredInformation: The exact compatible machine system for the specific capsule or pod, including relevant exclusions.
questions.sampleFinding: The sample explicitly names Nespresso Original Line. AI has a specific compatibility statement to use rather than treating every Nespresso system as interchangeable.
questions.scope: Selected products relevant to this question; illustrative scope only

questions.question: Can AI direct the customer to a place to buy the recommended product?
questions.requiredInformation: A clear purchase route associated with the exact product, including any relevant location limits.
questions.sampleFinding: The selected product pages include direct purchase routes. AI can point to the product’s buying options; local stock still requires a separate check.
questions.scope: Selected products relevant to this question; illustrative scope only

questions.question: Can AI recommend an option for the customer’s caffeine preference?
questions.requiredInformation: Which relevant products are regular or decaf, with any stated caffeine amount tied to the correct product and serving size.
questions.sampleFinding: The example does not clearly connect caffeine and decaf information to the products being compared. AI cannot confidently select for that preference from this sample.
questions.scope: Selected products relevant to this question; illustrative scope only

questions.question: Can AI compare value when the customer asks for an affordable coffee?
questions.requiredInformation: Comparable pack sizes, current purchase prices and a stated serving amount or yield. Any calculated cost per serving must show its assumptions.
questions.sampleFinding: The sample does not provide enough connected price and serving information for a fair comparison. Calling the coffee “affordable” would not establish that it meets a specific budget.
questions.scope: Selected products relevant to this question; illustrative scope only

fixes.title: State specific product differences in a short, factual summary.
fixes.guidance: Use supported product attributes; never invent tasting notes.
